description: [forged] Offline structural validator for Bangladesh NID (10, 13 or 17-digit National ID) and Pakistan CNIC (13-digit Computerized National Identity Card). Normalizes input, checks digit-count/format rules, extracts embedded birth year for 17-digit BD NIDs, and derives gender parity for PK CNICs (last digit odd=male, even=female). No checksum digit is publicly documented for either scheme, so validation is purely structural. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

id.description: The ID/CNIC string, with or without dashes/spaces
